summary.text: Ahsen Malik is an independent candidate for Virginia's 10th District. A middle school teacher with a background in residential mortgage finance and real estate, he describes himself as a uniter and an outsider, and his Ballotpedia survey responses emphasize congressional authority over war and ending government shutdowns.

paragraphs.text: Malik was born and raised in Virginia, according to his Ballotpedia survey response, and he describes himself as the son of an immigrant and the father of two children.

His campaign website says his professional background is in education, residential mortgage finance and real estate, and he works as a middle school teacher; the Virginia Mercury's voter guide describes him as a political newcomer.
Malik says he decided to run for Congress after finding only a single candidate on a House ballot in a past election.
He is running as an independent, and his campaign website describes being an outsider as a strength and says he is running to bring Americans on the left, right and center together.
